title: PTCG Search Agent Engine Bundle (v7, real expectimax/ISMCTS core)

resources.description: Vendored battle-engine SDK entrypoint (same real Pokemon TCG engine used by the Simulation Category runtime).
Engine API: Observation/Card/Pokemon dataclasses, CardType/EnergyType/OptionType enums, all_card_data()/all_attack() table loaders.
Real battle loop: battle_start / battle_select / battle_finish, backed by the compiled engine binary.
Compiled real battle-engine binary the SDK's Python wrappers call into -- not a mock or a re-implementation.
Low-level engine simulation bindings used by game.py/api.py.
Engine SDK helper utilities.
build_agent(deck) -- the real submission entrypoint: heuristic base policy, v4 expectimax search hook, v7 plan-stability hook, all wired together exactly as shipped.
Real dynamic pokemon/attack scoring (dyn_damage, weakness/resistance/stadium-adjusted damage, counter-aware bench targeting).
Real damage-calculation helpers shared by the heuristic and search layers.
Real per-OptionType scoring used to rank every legal action the engine offers.
The real v4 2-ply expectimax search layer: rank_attack_candidates(), opponent-reply fast-forward, ExpectimaxConfig.
Real forward-search helpers the expectimax layer calls into the actual engine with (search_begin/search_step/search_end).
Loads config/search_config.yaml into an ExpectimaxConfig; also the dataclass every script constructs explicitly for a given real A/B run.
Real per-agent-lifetime search cache (transposition table) used by the expectimax layer.
Real belief-state proxy over the opponent's hidden hand, built from observed board/discard state, used to bias ISMCTS-style determinization instead of uniform sampling.

Real learned leaf-value model wrapper (LogisticRegression / GradientBoosting over 19 hand-engineered features) -- opt-in only; real A/B result was a null result, so it is not the default leaf evaluator.
Real 19-feature state featurizer used to train/run the learned leaf-value model.
Real self-play replay logging/loading used to build the learned leaf-value model's training set.
Real local TrueSkill-style ladder rating + matchup-conditioned evaluation layer.
Real named-threat handling: Alakazam ex hand-size damage scaling.
Real named-threat handling: Bellibolt ex.
Real named-threat handling: Cornerstone Ogerpon (v6 correctness fix, grounded in printed card text).
Real named-threat handling: Crustle ex wall/immunity interaction in damage calculation.
Real attack-plan bonus/penalty logic, including the v7 plan-stability hook.
Real deck-file loading helpers.
Real thin wrapper isolating the rest of the agent from raw engine dict shapes.
Real card/attack table caching over cg.api.all_card_data()/all_attack().
Test-only mock of the engine's observation shape, used by the unit-test suite -- not used in real self-play or by the notebook.

The repo's checked-in search config file, with every flag's real, measured A/B result documented inline. NOTE: this copy may carry a local debugging override (search enabled at a since-superseded depth/leaf-mode combination) -- the accompanying notebook does not read this file; it constructs ExpectimaxConfig explicitly in code for the validated, real winning configuration, and says so.
Trained v5 logistic-regression leaf-value model (real A/B result: null, not shipped as default).
Trained v7 gradient-boosted-tree leaf-value model (real A/B result: null, not shipped as default).
The real 60-card decklist this agent and every cited A/B result were run with.
What this bundle is, how to attach it to a Kaggle notebook, and exactly which real, validated agent configuration to construct in code.
